ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ الْأَئِمَّةِ الْأَعْيَانِ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Al-A’immati ‘l-a`yān.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family the eminent leaders!

ar: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَ سَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ الْعَالِي الْقَدْرِ الْعَظِيْمِ الْجَاهِ .
tr: Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Al-Āli ‘l-qadri ‘l-aẓīmi ‘l-jāh.
en: O Allah send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family of Outstanding Destiny of Great Dignity!

ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ وَ أَطْلِعْنَا عَلَى أَسْرَارِ لَآ إِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Wa aṭli`nā `alā asrāri lā ilāha illa ‘lLāh.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family and disclose to us the secret of "La ilaha illa Allah!”
